description: This file defines the Offset class which implements the OFFSET function similar to Excel. It calculates a cell or range reference offset from a starting cell based on provided parameters, highlights the logic to extract worksheet and cell references, and includes helper methods for adjusting cell ranges.

classes.name: Offset
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate offset cell ranges based on parameters similar to the Excel OFFSET function.

methods.name: OFFSET
methods.description: Calculates and returns a cell or range of cells offset from a starting reference based on specified row/column/height/width parameters. Handles worksheet extraction and error cases.

methods.name: extractRequiredCells
methods.description: Retrieves the cell range from the worksheet based on the calculated cell address.

methods.name: extractWorksheet
methods.description: Extracts worksheet and cell references from a cell address, handling sheet names and references.

methods.name: assessCellAddress
methods.description: Expands named references or formulas in cell address strings.

methods.name: adjustEndCellColumnForWidth
methods.description: Calculates the ending column index based on width parameter and other inputs.

methods.name: adustEndCellRowForHeight
methods.description: Calculates the ending row index based on height parameter and other inputs.
